column1: # Blackout intercom: crew-only scenes for the radio blackout (phase blackout). New keys: bl_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.

column12: english
Hello? Mission Control? | Control? Hello? | Mission Control, do you read?

column11: No nos oyen. Es el apagón de radio.
column12: They can't hear us. It's the radio blackout. | Radio blackout. They can't hear us. | They can't hear anything right now, {other}.

column11: Por fin un poco de intimidad.
column12: Finally some privacy. | Privacy, at last. | Finally, some alone time.

column11: Control no nos oye. Es el momento de confesar.
column12: Control can't hear us. Now's the time to confess. | Control can't hear us. Time to confess. | {other}, nobody's listening. Confess.
Okay. I ate your sandwich. | Fine. I ate your sandwich. | Okay. It was me. The sandwich.
I knew it. | I knew it! | I knew it was you.

column11: La ventana se ha puesto rosa.
column12: The window turned pink. | The window is pink now. | {other}, why is the window pink?
It's plasma. It's normal. | Plasma. Totally normal. | That's plasma. It's fine.

column11: Es precioso y me da miedo.
column12: It's beautiful and it scares me. | Beautiful. And terrifying. | It's lovely and I hate it.
Do you trust the heat shield? | Do you trust the heat shield, {other}? | Is the heat shield any good?
They bought it on sale. | They bought it on sale. | It was on discount.
You're not helping. | You're not helping. | Not helpful.

column11: Di algo, para saber si funciona el intercomunicador.
column12: Say something so I know the intercom works. | Say something. I want to know the intercom works. | {other}, talk. Testing the intercom.
Something. | Something. | Words. There.
Thanks. Very helpful. | Thanks. Super helpful. | Wow. Very useful.
How long until the signal comes back? | When does the signal come back? | {other}, how long till we have signal?
I'll count to a hundred. One, two... | I'll count to a hundred. One, two... | Let me count. One, two, three...
Count faster. | Faster. | Count quicker, please.

column11: Si no lo logramos, los aperitivos están bajo mi asiento.
column12: If we don't make it, the snacks are under my seat. | If we don't make it, the snacks are under my seat. | {other}, if this goes wrong, snacks are under my seat.

column11: Si no lo logramos, no los necesitaré.
column12: If we don't make it, I won't need them. | If we don't make it, I won't need snacks. | If it goes wrong, snacks won't matter.
Then eat them now. | Then eat them now. | So eat them now.
Are you hot too? | Hot in here, or is it me? | {other}, are you hot too?
It's much hotter outside. | It's way hotter outside. | Outside is much hotter.
That doesn't comfort me. | Not comforting. | That doesn't help.
Since nobody is listening... | Since nobody's listening... | {other}, since Control can't hear us...
Yes? | Yes? | Go on.
I never read the manual. | I never read the manual. | I didn't read the manual. Ever.
Nobody did. | No one did. | Nobody ever does.
This shakes like a washing machine. | It shakes like a washing machine. | We're in a washing machine.
A very expensive washing machine. | A very pricey washing machine. | A really expensive one.
Wave at the plasma. | Wave at the plasma. | {other}, say hi to the plasma.
Hello, plasma. | Hi, plasma. | Hello there, plasma.
It's not waving back. | It isn't waving back. | Rude. No wave back.
Sing something to calm us down. | Sing something calming. | {other}, sing. Calm us down.

column11: La la la, no nos vamos a derretir...
column12: La la la, we're not going to melt... | La la la, we won't melt today... | La la la, we are not melting...
Stop. Just stop. | Stop. Please stop. | No. Stop singing.

column11: Si pasa algo, te dejo mi colección de piedras.
column12: If something happens, you get my rock collection. | If anything happens, my rock collection is yours. | {other}, you can have my rocks if this goes wrong.
They're ordinary rocks. | They're just rocks. | Those are normal rocks.
They're rocks with love. | Rocks with love. | Rocks with feelings.
Do you think Control is worried? | Is Control worried, do you think? | {other}, is Control worried about us?
They're probably eating cake. | They're eating cake, probably. | I bet they're having cake.
Without us. How unfair. | Without us. Unfair. | Cake without us. Rude.
